source.selection: 探索性定向采样；列表、详情、关键词与用户反馈分别计数。
sampleSelections: 已登录账户的精选分类，选择当次可见序列前24条；可能受个性化和编辑排序影响。

methods.fieldSemanticLimit: 列表无标签；不把计数当播放量、点赞量、点赞率或用户数。详情只在源文件注明图标顺序核对时按点赞/评论/收藏/分享解析。
methods.abbreviatedUnits: 万 × 10000、亿 × 100000000；只换算显示中心值，不重建精确底数。带单位的原文本和status保留；不能据此断言平台按四舍五入还是截断显示。
methods.quantile: Sorted values, linear interpolation at (n-1)*p (Hyndman-Fan type 7)
methods.top10PercentShare: Largest ceil(0.1*validN) displayed counts / sum of valid displayed counts; ties not expanded. This describes count concentration, not user concentration.
methods.missing: null or unparseable remains null; excluded from numeric denominators and separately counted
methods.correlation: Spearman with average ranks for ties; report only when pairedN >= 20 and at least 5 unique values on each axis. Also Pearson(duration,log1p(count)) and removal of largest count if >=20 pairs remain. No p-values/inferential population claims; recommendation sample is not random.
methods.authors: Use existing anonymized authorCode as identity key; no independent identity verification. HHI = sum((author placements / known-author placements)^2).
methods.keywords: Exact duplicate cards within an observation are removed; for each keyword retain the last complete explicitly labeled search-index observation. Do not replace missing with zero or sum index averages.
